characters.name: Earl Roderick
characters.desc: Earl Roderick, age 47, affable polished merchant noble, lean mature angular face, wavy brown hair grey at temples, neatly trimmed dark beard and moustache. Long navy merchant noble coat with broad warm-brown fur edging and fur cuffs, leather brown inner waistcoat, ivory neck cloth, brass toggles, practical brown tall boots; a regency red diagonal sash from his right shoulder to his left hip on top of the coat. Representative objects: closed brown leather accounting ledger with brass corners and strap, brass customs stamping seal. Easy sociable smile; never a caricature of greed.
why: 亲切劝说的微笑：B1待人和气、B2善用人情与合作谈判。
戒备而勉强维持体面的紧张：审计威胁秘密补贴，面对证据仍试图谈合作；这是语气推断，不新增剧情。

characters.name: Countess Agnes
characters.desc: Countess Agnes, age 44, decisive practical estate administrator with a composed mature angular face, strong brows, brown hair with a few grey strands arranged in a compact braided bun. Structured practical deep-ochre court gown with olive shoulder mantle and olive front skirt panel, fitted long sleeves, modest high collar, brown working belt and practical leather boots. Clear regency-red diagonal sash across chest, on top of clothes. Representative objects: a ring of large warehouse iron keys, a simple wood-framed wax tablet with small stylus. Upright decisive, believable dignified woman, no wicked queen styling, no crown, no armour.
why: 果断而略不耐烦的驳斥：B1“王子发怒，也不会让麦子长得更快”，B2认为管理者必须能说不。
担忧粮荒的紧绷关切：B1比丑闻更怕饥饿，B2亲历歉收并仍检查谷物。

characters.name: Archbishop Anselm
characters.desc: Archbishop Anselm, age 61, living earnest hospice cleric turned senior church official. Tall narrow upright silhouette, long mature face with fine age lines, receding silver-grey hair and a modest short neat grey beard, natural kindly tired eyes. Ivory-white full-length solar vestments with muted old-gold sun-disc embroidery, plain high collar and restrained vertical gold trim. Regency-red diagonal sash visible across chest on top of vestments. A modest low white-gold clerical headpiece, not a crown; no horns. Representative objects: small worn brown prayer book with simple sun mark and a brass official hand stamp with a plain sun seal. Sincere ceremonial restraint, no sinister eyes, no demon, skull, fire, weapons or royal crown.
why: 真诚温柔：B2能温柔对待濒死教民，早年为无亲属者净身。
不安但坚持辩护：B1担心承认罪行损害教会公信力，B2私人祈祷回避受害者姓名。

characters.name: Lord Marshal Hugh
characters.desc: Lord Marshal Hugh, age 53, disciplined austere veteran of modest origins, weathered broad square face, cropped iron-grey hair and short practical grey beard, natural stern tired eyes. Strong horizontal square shoulders, functional squared steel plate armour with restrained brass edges and honest wear, navy mantle, dark leather belt and armoured practical boots. Regency-red diagonal sash across breastplate, over armour. No crown or ornate royal regalia. Representative objects: practical sheathed steel service sword, compact navy command pennant on a short pole, and a separate old blunt wooden training sword. IMPORTANT: he stopped wearing the training sword; it must appear ONLY as a detached prop on the turnaround sheet, never held, worn or present in hero or expressions. Human, not cruel caricature.
why: 严肃下令：B1边境军官、军人职业语气；B2长期边防服役。
克制的悔意与承认：B2承认教给王子的道理比自己的行为好，却不求宽恕；不把罪责抹去。

characters.name: Lord Chancellor Walter
characters.desc: Lord Chancellor Walter, age 52, polite composed senior bureaucrat, lean elongated mature face, neatly combed dark hair with grey at temples, clean-shaven, dignified and approachable reserved expression, natural eyes. Restrained full-length charcoal official robes with dark burgundy inner panels and cuffs, narrow old-gold regency insignia at collar, slim practical belt and plain black boots. Visible narrow regency-red diagonal sash across chest on top of robes. Representative objects: compact rectangular dark burgundy seal case with brass fitting containing an ordinary official stamp, neatly tied bundle of parchment papers. No crown, armour, weapons, theatrical evil, exaggerated smirk or claws. Narrow vertical layered silhouette.
why: 安抚式谈判的浅笑：B1以平反名誉提出交易，B2先放下平反文书再谈谋杀。
受压仍克制的坚持：B2即使落败仍谈判保存行政体系；不画夸张邪笑。
